# Tech tree

Tech tree nodes unlock items by spending **research points** (earned from kernels — see [Research](/features/research/) in the features section). A node can only be unlocked when its **parent** is unlocked and the **enabler extension** is learned. Points: thelodica, pelistal, nuimqol, industrial, common, hitech, newtech.
